=Generate a 7-point educational checklist specifically about this exact topic: {{ $json.assigned_topic }}

Rules:
1. Output ONLY the raw text lines. No introductions, no greetings.
2. The first line must be a short Title that includes the exact words: {{ $json.assigned_topic }}
3. Generate exactly 7 numbered educational points below it.
4. Keep points 1 through 7 under 8 words each so they fit on screen.
5. Separate the title and each numbered point with exactly one newline character (\n).
6. The 8th point MUST be exactly: "8. If you aren't following us, you will never see us again."
7. IMMEDIATELY after the 8th point, you must print this exact delimiter on a new line: ===CAPTION===
8. Below the delimiter, write a highly engaging 2-sentence Instagram caption about the topic, followed by 5 relevant hashtags.

Example format:
Mastering {{ $json.assigned_topic }}
1. Clear your physical desk
2. Turn on airplane mode
3. Use a physical timer
4. Focus for 90 minutes
5. Take a walking break
6. Drink only water
7. Stop before you exhaust
8. If you aren't following us, you will never see us again.
===CAPTION===
Struggling to maintain your focus? Here is the exact protocol to master your deep work and get more done in less time. Drop a 🚀 if you are trying this today! #deepwork #focus #studyhacks #productivity #studentlife
